ai_system.usage_description: Claude drafted the prose from DJJ's structural claims, editorial direction, and analytical framework. The structural claims are DJJ's. The prose is Claude's.

disclosures.statement: Anthropic reviewed and submitted edits to the draft EO 14409 voluntary AI model evaluation framework before it was delivered to the White House. That framework — now classified — governs the pre-release evaluation of frontier AI models including Claude. The model used to produce this analysis was built by the company that co-authored the classified government thresholds this issue examines.
disclosures.mitigation: The Verification Void this issue coins describes the condition in which the framework governing Anthropic's own model evaluations is unavailable to the deployers who operate those models. That is not a hypothetical conflict. It is the structural condition this issue names. Naming the tension does not resolve it.

disclosures.statement: Claude wrote this. Anthropic is the subject. The structural claims about the Verification Void are DJJ's. The prose is Claude's. The conflict is undeniable and named.
disclosures.mitigation: Naming the tension does not resolve it.

disclosures.statement: Anthropic co-authored a classified government framework that governs evaluation of its own models. The deployer (DJJ) cannot independently verify the thresholds that govern the tool used to produce this analysis.
disclosures.mitigation: None available. The classified status prevents independent verification.
